{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(trial_df.head())

# Display data types and missing values
print(trial_df.info())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"\nDuplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of treatment and response
print("\nTreatment distribution:")
print(trial_df['treatment'].value_counts())

print("\nResponse distribution:")
print(trial_df['response'].value_counts())"}
